recipes.name: Deviled eggs
ingredients: 1 teaspoon pickle juice or white vinegar
Paprika and chopped chives to top
steps: Put the eggs in a pot and cover with cold water by 1 inch.
Bring to a boil, then turn off the heat, cover and let sit for 12 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Move the eggs to a bowl of ice water for 10 minutes.
Peel the eggs and cut them in half lengthwise.
Pop the yolks into a bowl and mash with the mayo, mustard, pickle juice, salt and pepper.
Spoon or pipe the yolk mix back into the whites.
Sprinkle with paprika and chives. Keep in the fridge.

recipes.name: Hot spinach artichoke dip
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 400 g) artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
10 oz (285 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Squeeze the spinach in a clean towel until no more water comes out.
Stir the cream cheese, sour cream, mayo, parmesan, half the mozzarella and the garlic until smooth.
Stir in the artichokes, spinach and salt.
Spread in a small baking dish and top with the rest of the mozzarella.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbly and golden.
Serve warm with tortilla chips, pita chips or bread.

recipes.name: Queso dip
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) white American cheese from the deli, torn
1 can (4 oz / 115 g) diced green chiles
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium low heat and whisk in the flour for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Slowly whisk in the milk and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until a little thick.
Add the cheeses a handful at a time, stirring until melted and smooth.
Stir in the green chiles, cumin and garlic powder.
Serve warm with tortilla chips. Stir in a splash of milk if it gets thick.

recipes.name: Seven layer dip
ingredients: 1 cup (260 g) salsa, drained a little
1/4 cup sliced black olives and 2 sliced green onions
steps: Stir the refried beans and taco seasoning and spread in a 9 inch dish.
Spread the sour cream over the beans.
Spread the guacamole on top, then the salsa.
Sprinkle on the cheese and lettuce.
Top with olives and green onions.
Serve with tortilla chips, or chill for up to 4 hours.

recipes.name: Buffalo chicken dip
ingredients: 2 cups (250 g) shredded cooked chicken, like rotisserie chicken
1/2 cup (120 ml) ranch or blue cheese dressing
1 cup (115 g) shredded cheddar or mozzarella
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Stir the cream cheese, dressing and hot sauce until smooth.
Stir in the chicken and half the cheese.
Spread in a small baking dish and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes, until hot and bubbly.
Serve with celery, crackers or tortilla chips.

recipes.name: French onion dip
steps: Chop the onions small. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium low heat and add the onions and salt.
Cook for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and deep golden brown.
Let cool for 15 minutes.
Stir the onions into the sour cream, mayo, garlic powder, Worcestershire and pepper.
Chill for 1 hour. Serve with potato chips.

recipes.name: Baba ganoush
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Poke the eggplant all over with a fork and put it on a lined baking sheet.
Roast for 40 to 45 minutes, turning once, until it collapses and is very soft.
Let cool for 15 minutes, then cut it open and scoop the flesh into a strainer to drain for 5 minutes.
Mash the eggplant with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and salt.
Spread in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with pita.

recipes.name: Fluffy fruit dip
ingredients: Fruit to dip: strawberries, apple slices, grapes, pineapple
steps: Beat the cream cheese until smooth.
Beat in the marshmallow creme and zest until fluffy.
Spoon into a bowl and serve with fruit. Keep in the fridge.

recipes.name: Trail mix
ingredients: 1 cup (145 g) roasted peanuts or almonds
steps: Put everything in a big bowl.
Stir to mix.
Scoop 1/2 cup into small bags for each serving.
Store in a sealed container for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Chewy granola bars
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Spread the oats and almonds on a baking sheet and toast for 10 minutes. Put them in a big bowl.
Line an 8 by 8 inch pan with parchment.
Heat the honey, butter and brown sugar in a pot until it bubbles, then simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Take it off the heat and stir in the peanut butter, vanilla and salt.
Pour over the oats and stir well.
Press firmly into the pan and let cool for 10 minutes, then press the chocolate chips on top.
Chill for 2 hours, then cut into 12 bars.

recipes.name: No-bake energy balls
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground flax or chia seeds
steps: Stir everything together in a bowl.
Chill for 30 minutes so it is easier to roll.
Roll into 1 inch balls.
Keep in a sealed container in the fridge for up to a week.

recipes.name: Puppy chow
ingredients: 9 cups (about 270 g) rice or corn Chex cereal
steps: Put the cereal in a very big bowl.
Microwave the chocolate chips, peanut butter and butter for 1 minute, stir, then 30 seconds more until smooth.
Stir in the vanilla.
Pour over the cereal and gently stir until coated.
Put the cereal in a big zip bag with the powdered sugar, seal and shake until coated.
Spread on a tray to cool for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Oven party mix
steps: Heat the oven to 250°F (120°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the cereals, nuts, pretzels and bagel chips in a big roasting pan.
Stir the butter, Worcestershire and spices together.
Pour over the mix and stir until coated.
Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Spread on paper towels to cool.

recipes.name: Caramel popcorn
ingredients: 12 cups (about 100 g) popped popcorn, from 1/2 cup kernels
steps: Heat the oven to 250°F (120°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put the popcorn in a big greased roasting pan and pick out any unpopped kernels.
Heat the brown sugar, butter, corn syrup and salt in a pot, stirring, until it boils. An adult should do this, the caramel is very hot.
Boil for 4 minutes without stirring.
Take it off the heat and stir in the baking soda and vanilla. It will foam.
Pour over the popcorn and stir to coat.
Bake for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.
Spread on parchment to cool for 15 minutes, then break apart.

recipes.name: Kettle corn
steps: An adult should do this. Melted sugar and oil are very hot.
Heat the oil and 3 kernels in a big pot with a lid over medium high heat until the kernels pop.
Add the rest of the kernels and the sugar and stir quickly.
Cover and shake the pot all the time for 2 to 3 minutes, until the popping slows to 2 seconds apart.
Pour into a big bowl right away so the sugar does not burn.
Sprinkle with salt and toss. Let cool for 5 minutes, it clumps as it cools.

recipes.name: Furikake popcorn
steps: Put the popcorn in a big bowl.
Drizzle with the melted butter while tossing.
Sprinkle on the furikake and toss again.
Stir in the rice crackers.

recipes.name: Crispy roasted chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Dry the chickpeas really well with a towel and pull off any loose skins.
Toss with the oil on a baking sheet.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, shaking the pan halfway, until crunchy.
Toss the hot chickpeas with the salt, paprika and garlic powder.
Let cool for 5 minutes. They get crunchier as they cool.

recipes.name: Kale chips
steps: Heat the oven to 300°F (150°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pull the kale leaves off the stems and tear into big chip size pieces.
Wash and dry them completely. Wet kale steams instead of crisps.
Toss with the oil and rub it into every leaf.
Spread in one layer on 2 baking sheets and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until crisp but still green.
Sprinkle with parmesan.

recipes.name: Baked tortilla chips
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush both sides of the tortillas lightly with oil.
Stack them and cut into 6 wedges each.
Spread in one layer on 2 baking sheets and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp and golden.
Squeeze lime over the warm chips.

recipes.name: Pita chips
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut each pita into 8 wedges and pull the layers apart.
Toss with the oil, salt and garlic powder.
Spread in one layer on a baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until golden and crisp.

recipes.name: Homemade cheese crackers
steps: Pulse the cheese, butter, flour and salt in a food processor until crumbly.
Add the water and pulse until a ball forms.
Wrap and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll 1/8 inch thick and cut into 1 inch squares or fun shapes.
Poke a hole in the middle of each with a skewer and put them on a lined sheet.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until puffed and the edges are golden.

recipes.name: Pigs in a blanket
ingredients: 1 can (8 oz / 225 g) crescent roll dough
24 cocktail sausages, or 8 hot dogs cut in thirds
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Unroll the dough and split it into 8 triangles.
Cut each triangle into 3 thin strips.
Roll each sausage up in a strip, starting at the wide end.
Put them seam side down on a lined sheet and brush with egg.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden.
Serve warm with ketchup and mustard.

recipes.name: Mozzarella sticks
ingredients: 12 mozzarella string cheese sticks, cut in half
Vegetable oil for frying, or cooking spray for the air fryer
steps: Roll each cheese piece in flour, dip in egg, then roll in breadcrumbs.
Dip in egg and breadcrumbs a second time so the cheese cannot leak out.
Freeze for 1 hour. This keeps them from melting too fast.
An adult should fry. Heat 2 inches of oil to 350°F (175°C) and fry a few at a time for 1 to 2 minutes, until golden.
Or air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 6 to 7 minutes, sprayed with oil.
Drain on paper towels and serve right away with warm marinara.

recipes.name: Baked jalapeno poppers
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Wear gloves and have an adult cut the jalapenos in half lengthwise and scrape out the seeds. Do not touch your eyes.
Mix the cream cheese, cheddar, garlic powder and bacon.
Fill each pepper half and put them on a lined baking sheet.
Sprinkle with panko.
Bake for 20 minutes, until the filling is bubbly and golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Tomato bruschetta
ingredients: 1 garlic clove, minced, plus 1 whole clove for rubbing
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Dice the tomatoes. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Stir the tomatoes, minced garlic, basil, 2 tablespoons oil, vinegar and salt. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Brush the bread with the rest of the oil and put it on a baking sheet.
Toast for 6 to 8 minutes, until golden.
Rub the warm toasts with the cut whole garlic clove.
Spoon the tomatoes on top just before serving.

recipes.name: Caprese skewers
steps: Thread a tomato, a folded basil leaf and a mozzarella ball onto each skewer.
Lay them on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Cheesy stuffed mushrooms
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Wipe the mushrooms clean and pull out the stems. Chop the stems small.
Cook the stems and garlic in the oil in a pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the cooked stems with the cream cheese, parmesan, breadcrumbs, parsley and salt.
Stuff each mushroom cap and put them on a baking sheet.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until golden and juicy.

recipes.name: Salted edamame
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) frozen edamame in pods
Optional: 1 teaspoon soy sauce and 1 minced garlic clove warmed in 1 teaspoon sesame oil
steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Add the edamame and boil for 4 to 5 minutes, until hot and tender.
Drain well.
Toss with the flaky salt, or the garlic and soy mix.
Squeeze the beans out of the pods with your teeth. Do not eat the pods.

recipes.name: Ants on a log
ingredients: 1/2 cup (130 g) peanut butter or sunflower seed butter
steps: Wash the celery and cut each stalk into 3 pieces with a butter knife.
Spread peanut butter into the groove of each piece.
Press a row of raisins on top like ants.

recipes.name: Apple nachos
steps: Have an adult core and thinly slice the apples.
Toss the slices with lemon juice so they stay white and spread them on a plate.
Microwave the peanut butter for 15 seconds so it drizzles.
Drizzle the peanut butter and caramel over the apples.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips and granola.

recipes.name: Oven s'mores
ingredients: 2 milk chocolate bars (1.55 oz / 44 g each), broken into pieces
steps: Turn on the oven broiler and put the rack near the top. Ask an adult to help.
Lay 8 cracker squares on a baking sheet and put chocolate and a marshmallow on each.
Broil for 1 to 2 minutes, watching the whole time, until the marshmallows are golden.
Press the other cracker squares on top.
For one in the microwave, heat the cracker, chocolate and marshmallow for 15 seconds.

recipes.name: Cinnamon sugar tortilla chips
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon.
Brush the tortillas with melted butter and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
Cut each into 8 wedges with a pizza cutter.
Spread on 2 baking sheets in one layer.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until crisp.
Serve with fruit salsa or fruit dip.

recipes.name: Chocolate covered pretzels
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) milk or white chocolate, chopped
steps: Line a tray with parchment.
Microwave the chocolate and coconut oil for 30 seconds at a time, stirring, until smooth.
Dip each pretzel with a fork, tap off the extra and lay it on the tray.
Add sprinkles right away.
Chill for 15 minutes, until set.

recipes.name: Cinnamon candied pecans
steps: Heat the oven to 250°F (120°C). Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the egg white and water until frothy.
Toss the pecans in the egg white until coated.
Mix the sugar, cinnamon and salt and toss with the pecans.
Spread on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then break apart.

recipes.name: Party cheese ball
steps: Beat the cream cheese, cheddar, garlic powder, Worcestershire and green onions until mixed.
Scoop onto plastic wrap and shape into a ball.
Wrap and chill for 1 hour, until firm.
Roll the ball in the pecans.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.name: Pizza pinwheels
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) pizza sauce, plus more to dip
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough into a 12 by 16 inch rectangle on a floured counter.
Spread with the sauce, leaving a 1 inch border on one long side.
Sprinkle with cheese, pepperoni and Italian seasoning.
Roll up from the long side and pinch the seam closed.
Cut into 12 slices and put them cut side up in a greased muffin pan or on a lined sheet.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden and bubbly.
Serve with warm sauce to dip.

recipes.name: Tortilla pinwheels
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely diced red bell pepper
steps: Mix the cream cheese, ranch seasoning, cheddar, bell pepper and green onions.
Spread a thin layer over each tortilla all the way to the edges.
Lay turkey slices on top.
Roll each tortilla up tight and wrap in plastic.
Chill for 1 hour.
Trim the ends and cut into 1 inch slices.

recipes.name: Cucumber cream cheese bites
steps: Cut the cucumber into 1/4 inch rounds. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Mix the cream cheese, dill and garlic powder.
Spread or pipe a little on each cucumber round.
Top with half a cherry tomato and a pinch of salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Bhel puri
steps: Boil the potato for 15 to 20 minutes, until soft. Ask an adult to help. Let cool, then peel and dice.
Chop the onion and tomato small.
Mix the potato, onion, tomato and cilantro in a big bowl.
Add the chutneys, chaat masala and lemon juice and stir.
Add the puffed rice and most of the sev and toss quickly.
Top with the rest of the sev and eat right away before it gets soggy.

recipes.name: Potato samosas
ingredients: Dough: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/4 cup (60 ml) vegetable oil, 1/3 to 1/2 cup (80 to 120 ml) water
3 medium potatoes (1 lb / 450 g), boiled, peeled and diced small
steps: Rub the oil into the flour and salt, then add water a little at a time to make a stiff dough. Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a pan and cook the cumin seeds and ginger for 30 seconds. Ask an adult to help.
Add the potatoes, peas, spices and salt and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in cilantro and let cool.
Split the dough into 6 balls, roll each into a 7 inch oval and cut in half.
Fold each half into a cone, sealing the edge with water, fill with potato and pinch the top shut.
An adult should fry. Heat 2 inches of oil to 325°F (163°C).
Fry a few at a time for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp. Low heat keeps the crust from bubbling.
Drain on paper towels. Serve with tamarind or mint chutney.

recipes.name: Vegetable pakoras
steps: Have an adult slice the onion and potato thinly.
Whisk the flours, salt and spices with enough water to make a thick batter like pancake batter.
Stir in the vegetables until coated.
An adult should fry. Heat 2 inches of oil to 350°F (175°C).
Drop small spoonfuls into the oil and fry for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper towels and serve with ketchup or mint chutney.

recipes.name: Scallion pancakes
ingredients: Dip: 2 tablespoons soy sauce and 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
steps: Have an adult pour the boiling water into the flour while you stir with chopsticks, then stir in cold water until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead for 5 minutes when cool enough to touch, cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Split into 4 balls. Roll one into a thin circle, brush with sesame oil and sprinkle with salt and scallions.
Roll it up like a rope, then coil the rope into a snail and flatten it into a 7 inch pancake.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and crisp.
Cut into wedges and serve with the dip.

recipes.name: Baked apple chips
steps: Heat the oven to 225°F (110°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult core the apples and slice them very thin, about 1/8 inch, with a mandoline or sharp knife.
Lay the slices in one layer on 2 parchment-lined baking sheets.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.
Bake for 1 hour, flip the slices, then bake for 1 hour more, until dry.
Turn off the oven and let them cool inside. They crisp up as they cool.

recipes.name: Strawberry fruit leather
steps: Heat the oven to 200°F (95°C). Ask an adult to help.
Blend the strawberries, honey and lemon juice until very smooth.
Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment or a silicone mat.
Spread the puree evenly about 1/8 inch thick.
Bake for 3 to 4 hours, until it is no longer sticky in the middle.
Let cool for 20 minutes, then cut into strips with scissors, paper and all, and roll up.

recipes.name: Banana sushi
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut butter or sunflower seed butter
2 tablespoons crispy rice cereal or granola
steps: Peel the banana and spread the peanut butter all over it.
Roll it in the cereal so it sticks.
Drizzle with honey.
Cut into 1 inch pieces with a butter knife, like sushi rolls.

recipes.name: Puff pastry cheese straws
ingredients: 1 sheet (about 9 oz / 245 g) puff pastry, thawed
1 cup (100 g) finely grated parmesan or cheddar
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Unfold the pastry on a floured counter and brush with egg.
Sprinkle with the cheese and paprika and press it in with a rolling pin.
Cut into 1/2 inch strips with a pizza cutter.
Twist each strip a few times and lay it on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Sausage rolls
ingredients: 1 sheet (about 9 oz / 245 g) puff pastry, thawed
1 lb (450 g) pork sausage meat, casings removed
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the sausage, onion, breadcrumbs and thyme with clean hands. Wash your hands after touching raw meat.
Cut the pastry in half lengthwise.
Shape the sausage into 2 long logs and lay one down the middle of each strip.
Brush one edge with egg, fold the pastry over and press with a fork to seal.
Cut each log into 6 pieces and put them on a lined sheet. Brush with egg.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until deep golden and the sausage reaches 160°F (71°C) inside.

recipes.name: Pimento cheese
ingredients: 1 jar (4 oz / 115 g) diced pimentos, drained
steps: Beat the cream cheese and mayo until smooth.
Stir in the cheddar, pimentos, garlic powder and cayenne.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Serve with crackers and celery, or spread on sandwiches.

recipes.name: Mexican fruit cup
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili lime seasoning like Tajin
steps: Have an adult help cut the fruit and vegetables into sticks and cubes.
Pile them into 4 cups.
Squeeze lime juice over the top.
Sprinkle with the chili lime seasoning and drizzle with chamoy.

recipes.name: Esquites
ingredients: 3 cups (450 g) corn kernels, fresh or frozen
2 tablespoons sour cream or Mexican crema
steps: Melt the butter in a big pan over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the corn and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring only now and then, until it has golden brown spots.
Take it off the heat and stir in the mayo, crema, most of the cotija, lime juice and salt.
Spoon into cups and top with the rest of the cotija, chili powder and cilantro.

recipes.name: Muhammara
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) jarred roasted red peppers, drained
1 tablespoon pomegranate molasses, or 1 teaspoon honey with 1 teaspoon lemon juice
steps: Put everything in a food processor.
Pulse until mostly smooth with a little texture.
Taste and add salt or lemon if needed.
Serve with pita chips or vegetables.

recipes.name: Parmesan crisps
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon black pepper or Italian seasoning
1 tablespoon sesame seeds or chopped herbs (optional)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Drop level tablespoons of cheese on the sheet 2 inches apart and pat into flat circles.
Sprinkle with pepper and seeds or herbs.
Bake for 5 to 7 minutes, until golden and lacy.
Let cool for 5 minutes on the sheet so they crisp.

recipes.name: Baked potato chips
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult slice the potatoes very thin, about 1/16 inch, with a mandoline.
Rinse the slices in cold water, then dry them really well with towels.
Toss with the oil and lay in one layer on parchment-lined sheets.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, flipping halfway. Take off any chips that brown early.
Sprinkle with salt and let cool for 5 minutes to crisp.

recipes.name: Watermelon pizza
ingredients: 1 round slice of watermelon, 1 inch thick, from the middle
steps: Have an adult cut a 1 inch thick round slice from the middle of the watermelon.
Stir the yogurt and honey and spread it over the slice like sauce.
Top with berries, kiwi and mint.
Cut into 8 wedges like a pizza and eat right away.

recipes.name: Cowboy caviar
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed
Dressing: 1/4 cup (60 ml) olive oil, 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar, 1 tablespoon lime juice, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1/2 teaspoon chili powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Dice the pepper and onion. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Put the beans, peas, corn, pepper, onion, tomatoes and cilantro in a big bowl.
Whisk the dressing and pour it over.
Stir and chill for 30 minutes.
Serve with tortilla chips or as a side.
